name: jmcarthur
description: Plugins for Claude Code: rootcause, runway, threads and tidy.

plugins.name: rootcause
plugins.description: A subagent that finds the root causes of a defect one question at a time, before the session fixes it.

plugins.name: runway
plugins.description: Switches subscriptions with claude-swap before a usage limit stops the work, resumes a session that a limit stopped, and, with tidy, suggests compacting before a long limit.

plugins.name: threads
plugins.description: Keeps a session's lines of thought as threads, each with its history and the questions waiting on you, in a pane beside the chat.

plugins.name: tidy
plugins.description: Gives the model a tool to compact its own context, suggests compacting at boundaries, and keeps the prompt cache warm while background work runs.
